text: The old trunk is hollow and ready to go. {lead} heaves, it topples, and out of the hollow rolls a few coins.
A gap in the wall, where the stones have gone for a walk. {lead} fits them back one by one, like a very slow jigsaw. Tucked in the wall behind: Hag Stone.
{lead} taps out a steady beat beside the hill and the earth begins to wriggle. Turned up with the worms: Bacon Rind.
A gap in the wall, where the stones have gone for a walk. {lead} fits them back one by one, like a very slow jigsaw. Tucked in the wall behind: Hag Stone.
Sheep at the gate, and no sheep will go first. {lead} comes round the back, low and quiet, and the flock files through. The farmer's thanks: Cream Tea.
The drystone has slumped. {lead} lifts the big stones in first and wedges the small ones after, which is exactly how it is done. Behind the stones: Hag Stone.
The old trunk is hollow and ready to go. {lead} heaves, it topples, and out of the hollow rolls Truffle.
